text:
sam: Heads up — nightly eval (run_id=nightly-2026-03-18-01) spiked on function-call JSON parse failures for redwood-4x-q8. Failure rate ~0.6% (12/2000). Posting one raw example and stack snippet below.

eval-bot: nightly-eval: run=nightly-2026-03-18-01 model=redwood-4x-q8 prompt_set=code-tooling-iter1 failures=12/2000 severity=medium

sam: ```
model_output: {
  "role": "tool",
  "name": "kb.search",
  "content": null,
  "function_call": {
    "name": "kb.search",
    "arguments": "{'query': \"user's error: \\\"NullPointer\\\"\", 'top_k': '5'}"
  }
}
error: ingest.parse_json: JSONDecodeError: Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes: line 1 column 3 (char 2)
```

alex: ugh the args are stringified with single quotes — looks like function_call.arguments is a string blob not a JSON object. can you paste the raw bytes/escaped output from the decoder (no pretty print)?

sam: ```raw
{"role":"tool","name":"kb.search","function_call":{"name":"kb.search","arguments":"{'query': \"user's error: \\\"NullPointer\\\"\", 'top_k': '5'}"}}
```

jin: did this start after q8 rollout yesterday? we only started quantizing redwood-4x to q8 on prod-nightly.

sam: yes. redwood-4x-fp16 baseline run had 1/2000 failures for same set. q8 has 12/2000.

maria: initial hypothesis: quantized generation path is emitting args as a single string (maybe model hallucinated a stringified dict). could also be beam/decoding truncation that drops a leading { or replaces quotes.

liam: another angle — runtime postproc might be coercing bytes<->str differently for q8 kernel (we changed a decode fallback last week). putting on infra radar. @infra-bot can you check decoder variants?

infra-bot: noticed change: commit 6f2b9a4 updated token_decoder fallback for q4/q8 optimized kernels. No obvious bug but added to watchlist.

alex: quick repro suggestion: rerun the failing prompt with top_p/temperature set to deterministic small values and print raw logits->tokens. if model emits leading single quote token before json, that explains it. sam can you run?

sam: ran local repro against q8 with temp=0.0 and got same behavior. token sequence shows tokens: ["{", "'", "query", ":"] ?? looks like tokenizer emitted single-quote token between braces.

maria: if tokenizer emits a single quote token then the emitted string uses single quotes which breaks json. why only q8 though? tokenization should be independent. maybe quantization changed softmax arg ordering causing different continuation choices near quote.

liam: temporary mitigation: at eval ingestion, try reparsing function_call.arguments if it's a string by attempting a) json.loads directly b) replace single quotes with double quotes heuristically and json.loads c) detect python-literal dict via ast.literal_eval — obviously risky, but for nightly evals we can mark repaired cases and not affect production inference.

alex: I can open a small PR that adds a "repair_json_arg" step in eval ingestion with a feature flag. If repair fails, keep original and tag the failure for triage. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/merge_requests/2345

sam: posted minimal stack trace from ingest pipeline: ```
File "ingest.py", line 142, in process_toolcall
  args = json.loads(msg["function_call"]["arguments"])
File "/usr/lib/python3.10/json/__init__.py", line 346, in loads
  return _default_decoder.decode(s)
json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes
```

jin: action items: 1) add ingestion repair + flag (alex) 2) re-run nightly for this commit (sam) 3) deeper model/regression debug (maria + liam) 4) add a quick eval that compares q8 vs fp16 token sequence for same prompts (jin)

liam: I'm pushing a tiny hotfix to staging ingestion now — tries ast.literal_eval fallback and tags repaired_count in metadata. will monitor next run.

infra-bot: hotfix deployed to staging ingestion (deploy id=deploy-2026-03-18-22). watching nightly schedule.

sam: rerun scheduled — will kick off targeted job for the 12 failing samples first.

maria: if repair reduces noise we can keep it in nightly only. but long-term fix probably needs model/regression: either decode logits or fix beam decoding randomness at quantized kernels.

alex: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/merge_requests/2345 — adds repair flag and test cases. please review.

sam: thanks. I'll post results of the rerun here. :eyes:

infra-bot: rerun complete: repaired=9 failed=3 total_checked=12 (next full nightly run in ~6h)

maria: great. putting a follow-up to run small token-level diff harness between q8 and fp16 and log divergence points.

sam: noted. will follow up after diffs. :thumbsup:
